evidence.A: SPDX parsed from fetched LICENSE/COPYING/terms blobs (sha256 stored). README badges are observed and ignored.
evidence.B: Host-declared licence metadata (GitHub API license.spdx_id, else captures_index.classifier_spdx, else ecosyste.ms.license). Transport errors are unavailable, not a classified null.
evidence.disagreement_rule: When A and B both exist and differ, the record is UNCLASSIFIED and escalated; neither signal is preferred.

findings.claim: A source with no discoverable licence blob defaults to adverse/most-restrictive treatment, not to a permissive README badge or API field.
A planted GPL-3.0 artefact fires the gate (COPYLEFT, MECHANISM_ONLY, no code carried) before silence on live captures is trusted.
Attribution-required (Apache-2.0) and rider-restricted (Commons Clause) sources produce explicit obligations records, with rider text verbatim.
File SPDX vs API SPDX disagreement is UNCLASSIFIED and escalated rather than resolved by preference.

user_prompts_legal_and_tor.note: _USER-PROMPTS.md legal/Tor policy slice is not in this worktree. A conservative ToS/Tor-evasion refuse rule is implemented and planted; the original prompt text was not paraphrased from memory.

question: For every externally acquired artifact: what licence actually governs it, does this estate's intended use — mechanism extraction rather than redistribution — comply, and which acquisitions must be refused or reduced to a described-mechanism-only record with no code carried across?

obligations.text: No discoverable LICENSE/COPYING/terms blob. Most-restrictive treatment applies: no code may be carried; at most a described-mechanism record. Permissive README badges and permissive API metadata do not relax this.

SPDX GPL-3.0 is copyleft. Intended estate use is mechanism extraction, not redistribution; source code must not be carried into this estate.
SPDX Apache-2.0 requires retaining copyright and licence notice with any copy or substantial portion. Mechanism-extraction notes that quote the source must carry that notice.
Apache-2.0: preserve NOTICE file contents if present, state material changes, and do not grant trademark rights.
SPDX MIT requires retaining copyright and licence notice with any copy or substantial portion. Mechanism-extraction notes that quote the source must carry that notice.
Rider or additional term is recorded verbatim; it is not normalised away to the base SPDX identifier.
